title: 2007.07.25-2_Raganuga-bhakti
en: So, after receiving dīkṣā from guru, one is allowed to serve the vigraha. Because the deity form of vigraha that in which we see the vigraha, this is the manifestation in this world of the mantropāsanāmayī-līlā-pīṭha. We want to enter into that līlā-pīṭha, but it's hard for us to meditate upon this, because you cannot see it. So, Guru said, “Oh, look, the Vigraha are here.” Now you can see. And even you can do this yoga-pīṭha-sevā. Here is all the paraphernalia that the sakhī is used. So, under guidance of guru-rūpa-sakhī, you should meditate by the way you serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in this līlā-pīṭha, and bring your paraphernalia and do ārati. It includes the devotees doing ārati and those who are also watching; all take part and enter into this līlā-pīṭha. This is why in a temple, morning, noon, and evening ārati, three times a day, all the devotees are going to make this saṁskāra, that gives the impression so that they can meditate on this.

title: Sri Radhastami part 2
en: Actually, when a pūjārī, the priest who is serving the deity, offers any articles to the deity, actually, he should offer the articles first by in the mind. And so, he's thinking, "Oh, in my svarūpa with my guru-rūpa-sakhī, my Gurudeva in Her svarūpa, and I am passing the articles and together we are serving Rādhikā." So when you do ṣoḍaśopacāra-pūjā, worship with 16 articles, each one is done by mind first, and then the actual physical article is done.

title: 2019.10.25 Seva-kunja
en: So, in Sevā-kuñja, Rādhikā serves Kṛṣṇa by letting Him serve Her. And the maidservants of Rādhikā serve both Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. When Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa come out from the kuñja, then some of the maidservants, they rush in there to tidy up and collect some mahā-prasāda remnants. Oh, there may be some chewed tāmbūla of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. Oh, and also the necklaces of Rādhā Rādhikā have been broken and the jewels are scattered here and there. So, they go into the kuñja to pick up the jewels, and restring and remake the necklaces again.

title: 2019.11.18 4 Legs of Raganuga Bhakti p.1 - Lobha
en: And the sādhaka feeling, "Ah, I am so wretched, I am so fallen." But in the association of the rasika Vaiṣṇavas who are relishing that melo, by hearing from them, sometimes he gets a chance to taste a few drops. So, we are like that. And when the devotee begins to realize how sweet internally from the his nāma-bhajana, how sweet is the relationship of the Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa with their associates, then he becomes completely infatuated and covetous, "Ah, I want that." Now he is the adhikārī for rāgānugā-bhakti. And he becomes completely focused in his sādhana, his service to Guru, and his nāma-bhajana.

title: Sri Prem Prayojan - 2019-06-24 - Ishtha-Goshthi
en: But in rāgānugā-bhakti there's no fixed conception, otherwise it would not be rāgānugā-bhakti. Then it will be vaidhi-bhakti again, "Now you have to think like this, now you have to think like this." Rāgānugā-bhakti is spontaneous. Outwardly it looks the same, but inwardly it's according to the taste and the realization of that particular devotee on that day. Yes. Everyone wants to know, "How do I do rāgānugā-bhakti?" you know? Cannot. "How? Please show me how to be spontaneous." "What are the three steps to become to be spontaneous?" You cannot, this is not a question. But wh- when we listen with a from our Gurudeva, here's a spontaneous mood then...

title: The Story of Nachiketu, Vibhāvarī-Śeṣa with Explanation
en: At that time in the early morning, the mañjarīs, they were awake almost the whole night, but just towards the end of the night, they lie down on the—in the courtyard, just outside the kuñja. And then suddenly, Maidservant wakes up and looks around because she's afraid, "Oh, did I oversleep? Did I miss my service?" And then she looks around, sees, "Oh, others are still resting, Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa are still sleeping." Sigh. Relief. "I thought—for a moment I was very anxious, but now I see there's still time." So then that devotee is remembering his spiritual form, will get up and go and wake up Gurudeva. Understand? That means wake up another sakhī, another other mañjarīs who are there. And then go to see, uṭho, nidrā chāḍi’ uṭha jīva, "Oh, my life and soul, wake up." And they'll go, and they look inside: "Oh, in this beautiful kuñja-bhavana, this pavilion of flowers in the forest of Vṛndāvana on the bank of Yamunā, see Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Śyāmasundara resting there."

title: Mangala Arati - 2025-05-24
en: So first of all, we bow down to Guru. And by his mercy, by his permission, we approach Gaurāṅga. And by the mercy of Gaurāṅga, when we bow down to his līlā, then internally, we have a sphūrti, or the awakening of the realization of Radha Krishna's līlā. […] When Gaurāṅga Mahāprabhu is waking up in the morning, tears are flowing from his eyes. Why? Because he's remembering how Radha and Krishna are waking up in the morning. So Gaura-līlā is called udbodhaka-līlā. Udbodhaka-līlā means the pastime that awakens your realization of Radha and Krishna's pastimes. So don't try to go directly to Radha and Krishna. First remember Guru, then remember Gaurāṅga, Caitanya Mahāprabhu. And then by his mercy, his mercy will awaken the remembrance of Radha Krishna.

title: Who really knows Srimad-Bhagavatam
en: Oh Kṛṣṇa, please wake up and cast Your merciful glance upon the world. "And when by Your glance You wake up the world, wake up in my heart summaṅgala-rati, very auspicious rati, that is bhāva." […] One day Kṛṣṇa will say, "Okay." He will awaken. "You asked Me so many times, you woke up so early every day for so many years, and you begged Me for this, take." And Kṛṣṇa will give, and then you can hear the birds are singing, cuckoo birds are calling, peacocks are calling, and the sweet nectarine beautiful atmosphere of Vraja, where Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa awaken.

title: Mangala Arati - 2025-05-24
en: So at that time, then the maidservants come and with very nimble fingers, they quickly entangle Rādhikā's disheveled hair from her various ornaments. Sometimes her hair is entangled in Krishna's ornaments or Krishna's hair is entangled in Rādhikā's ornaments. So they're kind of tied together by the ropes of Cupid. And the maid servants come and untangle them. So then finally, they sit up, and the maid servants, they take a pot with a fragrant rose water, and they dip the some cloths in the water and begin to wipe the bodies of Radha and Krishna. Why? Because the kuṅkuma, the cosmetic from the chest of Rādhikā is on the feet of Krishna. The kājala from the eyes of Krishna are on the lips of Rādhikā. The lipstick from Rādhikā is on the body of Krishna. So in this way, they're actually decorated with each other's various decorations, cosmetics. Now their cosmetics have become successful by swapping over. At that time, one mañjarī is very clever, will come with a mirror and hold up a mirror before Śrīmatī Rādhikā.

title: Avirbhava, Appearance Day
en: So the pūjārī is offering some water and then offering a handkerchief. The bhāva is, first the light, first the mañjarīs come into the kuñja and they look, they take the dīpa and they look to see that how the eyeliner of Rādhikā is on Kṛṣṇa's lips, how the candana from Kṛṣṇa's chest is on Rādhikā's chest, like this. And they take the light and they look to see what they have to do, and then they give some water and then they get a handkerchief and you wipe off all the marks so when they return to the village no one will see that.

title: 2019.12.22 Meanings Of Japa And Mangala Arati
en: As these cihna are the signs of sambhoga meeting, then as they're being wiped away, that means it's as if they are erasing the pastime itself. And it's awakening the vipralambha-bhāva. When the sambhoga-cihna is wiped away, when meeting is wiped away, then you are left with separation. This is the bhāva of maṅgala-ārati. So the devotees are watching the ārati and seeing the offering of the water, the offering of the cloth like this, and the nectar of the union is being wiped away, and the pain of separation is rising up in the heart.

title: Meaning of Mangala Arati
en: Another maidservant takes a dīpa and does āratī because āratī means that which brings auspiciousness. So they're thinking, "Oh, I am offering āratī to Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, They will now get back to Their home without being caught, there should be no problems. No difficulties should come in Their life, and They should quickly again meet without any obstacles."

title: 2021.06.05 Bhajana Rahasya p.2
en: And They quickly sneak into Their houses and get in bed and pretend that They were there the whole night. So that is niśānta-līlā, 3:36 to 6:00. Then prātaḥ-līlā, morning pastimes, means that Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa in their Rādhikā is in Yāvaṭa, Kṛṣṇa is in Nandagāon. Mother Yaśodā comes in to wake up Śrī Kṛṣṇa. And in Yāvaṭa, the Mukharā, Rādhārāṇī's grandmother, comes to visit Her in the morning, "Oh, my granddaughter is still sleeping and the sun has already risen, what happened?" Rādhikā wakes up, and in the meantime Her maidservants they're preparing Her bathing room. And then She goes and they bathe Her and decorate Her very beautifully. It's prātaḥ-līlā. Then She goes to Nandagāon to cook in the kitchen of Mother Yaśodā. Kṛṣṇa wakes up, He goes and milks the cows, then comes back, takes bath, then takes breakfast, what Rādhikā has cooked. And then after a little rest, He leaves with the cows.

title: 2012.06.06 Гуру и ученик — Рагхунатх Дас Госвами
en: And Rati Mañjarī, she has so much love for Rādhārāṇī. She thought, "Now how can I polish dry and polish this the drains of this bathing place? What is good enough for cleaning Rādhārāṇī's bathing place?" Rati Mañjarī has so much love. She thinks, "Oh, it is not enough if I would clean it with my 72,000 prāṇas. I cannot. But I have thousands of hairs." So she untied her braid. And with her hair, then she's wiping the drain of the bathing place, "Because just now my Svāminī Rādhikā will come here." And feeling so much joy in her heart to have the opportunity to serve Rādhārāṇī in a such a menial way. Then she lit lots of incense, very fragrant incense. And make the atmosphere very good. And then she came out again, calling, "Bathing place is ready." So then Rādhārāṇī came. And Rati Mañjarī changed Her from Her cloth that She was wearing into very soft, thin, white, transparent cloth. And took some sugandhavat vartana, some exfoliating perfume powders. And began to massage Rādhārāṇī. She's seen how Kṛṣṇa touches Rādhikā. And gives Her massage. So she's doing exactly the same to remind Rādhārāṇī of Kṛṣṇa. And then she's giving bath, bathing Her. And decorating Her. So Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, he learned these things from Rūpa Gosvāmī. His śikṣā-guru described very beautiful pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

title: Disappearance Day of Sri Ray Ramananda
en: So each and every aspect of Rādhārāṇī's body, and cosmetics, and ornaments—ṣoḍaśa-śṛṅgāra, sixteen types of cosmetics, and dvādaśa-ābharaṇa, twelve types of golden ornaments—they're all various bhāvas of Śrīmatī Rādhikā. She's decorated in jewels; Her jewels are prema-vaicittya, Her sparkling jewels are the separation She feels in Kṛṣṇa's presence. So all of these things make Her svarūpa beautiful. So when you're decorating your Deities, just remember that all the śṛṅgāra was not bought from Loi Bazaar. Forget that! This śṛṅgāra is actually the all the various aspects of Rādhikā's mahā-bhāva. And then your service becomes rasamayī sevā.

title: Radha-Dhama and Lalita Saptami
en: How do they increase the līlā? By, oh the sakhīs take Rādhikā from her house in the middle of the night on abhisāra to go to meet with Krishna. And when Radha Krishna meet, afterwards, then they describe that līlā to Rādhikā while they're decorating her. And by hearing the description of the līlā that the sakhīs have seen, while she's being decorated, Rādhikā relives them all. Because from śravaṇam there is a sphūrti. she experiences all the līlās again new by hearing.

title: 2011.07.27_Talks about bhakti2
en: Before Rādhikā goes to meet with Kṛṣṇa, they decorate her very beautifully. And then they take a mirror and hold it in front of Rādhikā. Why? Because when Rādhikā sees her own beauty in the mirror, then she becomes overwhelmed with anxiety, "Oh, when will Śrī Kṛṣṇa taste this beauty?"

title: 23 10 2016 PavanSarovara
en: So at that time, Rādhikā is watching from a balcony through a lattice window. Because only the wife has the opportunity to cook, and give that food to her husband, and then watch and relish how her husband is relishing. But Rādhikā is having the same feeling, but because this is parakīya, it is hidden, so She's watching from a balcony and relishing how Kṛṣṇa is relishing Her cooking. And the maidservants of Rādhikā, they're watching Rādhikā, how Rādhikā is watching Kṛṣṇa relish. When Kṛṣṇa tastes the preparations, then in these preparations all the feelings, all the thoughts that Rādhikā was having while She was cooking, they appear in Kṛṣṇa's heart. So cooking is a very intimate service. Kṛṣṇa's body is made of that which Rādhikā has made with Her own hand.

title: Sri Prem Prayojan - 2016-06-22 - Sadhu-Sanga
en: He is offering his bhoga to Śrī Kṛṣṇa every day. Or first offering flowers at the feet of Gurudeva, and inviting Gurudeva, "Please, take your seat," and washing the lotus feet of Gurudeva, and then praying for permission to offer that bhoga to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, offering flowers at Their lotus feet, offering Them an āsana to sit, and requesting His deities, "Please come and be seated," washing the lotus feet of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, washing Their hands and mouth, offering the bhoga with tulasī leaves. He is doing this every day. In his heart he is relishing joy, realizing how Gurudeva in the form of a very dear priya-sakhī of Rādhikā, or maidservant of Rādhikā, Gurudeva is there and under the guidance of that maidservant of Rādhikā, they are actually serving Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, and Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa are enjoying their offerings.

title: Ratupur - Ko Bala (Radha Kunda)
en: So, Rādhā-kuṇḍa is Rādhikā's abhinna-svarūpa, non-different. It is the place of the madhyāhna, midday pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. Of all the yāmas, that means the eight periods of a day, the midday and midnight are the longest. So, the midday period goes from 10:48 in the morning till 3:36 in the afternoon. What kind of beautiful pastimes happen in Rādhā-kuṇḍa? Swinging, jhūlana-līlā. You know, if you sit on a swing with your beloved, and swing, then all your cares and worries go far away. They have the pāsā-krīḍā, means gambling. […] Holī-līlā, throwing colors. And when They're all covered in colors, They go into the water of Rādhā-kuṇḍa, and They splash each other and wash up all the colors into the water of Rādhā-kuṇḍa.

title: Sri Prem Prayojan - 2019-06-24 - Ishtha-Goshthi
en: When Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa meet in the kuñja, then so that Candrāvalī will not try to disturb anything, that Jaṭilā will not come, or Kuṭilā or Abhimanyu or anything, Lalitā is offering ārati to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa to remove any inauspiciousness. Also the mood of the ārati can be that whatever you see success, happiness comes from your piety. So whatever piety, whatever happiness I have this I'm offering to you so that you can be happy.

title: 2015.08.20 It's easy to practise bhkti (Практиковать бхакти легко)
en: If you serve your deities you can realize this. Vigraha. Because, though Kṛṣṇa, He can do everything Himself, but in the form of vigraha He stands very still. "You have to do everything for Me. You can make Me lie down, make Me stand up, bring Me food." Out of love He's not moving. But in your mind you thinking, "He's not moving because He's made out of metal." Don't think! You're thinking, "Kṛṣṇa's not talking." Why? Because He's remembering Rādhārāṇī, His voice is choked, He cannot say. If you serve your Ṭhākurajī you can realize it.

title: Sri Raya Ramananda Samvada part 17
en: So the rasika-vaiṣṇavas say, actually this Vraja-līlā is not Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa-līlā, it's sakhīs'-līlā. In say. It means the bring Rādhikā to meet with Krishna and they play. When they become tired, then the sakhī say, "Now take rest." and then they rest. When the sakhī see that they recovered a little bit, they say, "Oh, now you your tiredness has gone away and now again play. So the sakhī are just telling them to do everything.

title: 2021.06.05 Bhajana Rahasya p.2
en: Mother Yaśodā is standing at the gate of the village with Nanda Mahārāja and all the villagers, and they see the dust rising into the air, they hear the sound of the bells of the cows and the flutes of the cowherd boys, and they're looking very eagerly, and then gradually through the dust appears Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Balarāma, and all the cowherd boys. Mother Yaśodā is standing, tears are streaming from her eyes and milk is flowing from her breast, and she embraces her son and gives Him abhiṣeka in tears and milk. Kṛṣṇa comes back, has His evening meal, and then Dhaniṣṭhā, one servant in the house of Mother Yaśodā, gives some of Kṛṣṇa's remnants to Rati-mañjarī, and she takes it to Rādhārāṇī who's dying in separation in Yāvaṭa, and when Rādhikā gets Kṛṣṇa's mahā-prasāda remnant, then She floating in the ocean of bliss.

title: 01 11 16 KadambuKandi
en: Because, when Rādhikā is cooking, then all Her ecstatic love goes into those preparations. And when Kṛṣṇa tastes that, then what Rādhikā was feeling appears in His heart. And then He has new love for Rādhikā. Then when Kṛṣṇa's remnants are taken back to Rādhikā... And Rādhikā tastes the remnant of Kṛṣṇa... Then She has a sphūrti, She has a realization... Of what Kṛṣṇa was realizing... When He was realizing what Rādhikā was realizing when She was cooking. So in this way, through mahā-prasādam, there is very beautiful meeting of the hearts of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. And then, when the mañjarīs, they take the remnant of Rādhikā... Then they realize what Rādhikā was realizing, when She was realizing what Kṛṣṇa was realizing, when He was realizing what She was realizing when She was... So in this mood we take prasādam. Then you are really, actually honoring prasādam and not just eating like feeding time at the farm.

title: Gaura Arati p.2 [eng]
en: All of a sudden, Navadvīpa transforms and becomes Vṛndāvana yoga-pīṭha, and there Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are together and the āratī is being performed by Lalitā and the sakhīs like this. So this is the method by which the followers of Caitanya Mahāprabhu can enter into Vraja-līlā through Gaura-līlā.

title: Holi-Lila part 2
en:
So who is singing this song? Rūpa Mañjarī, a very proud citizen of the kingdom of Vṛndāvana, all ready to die for her queen. How proud they are!

"Cāmara ḍulāye." […] The cāmara has, oh, thousands and thousands of hairs. So in the same way, in your body, the prāṇa is moving in 72,000 nāḍīs. So the mañjarīs are fanning Rādhikā gently with the cāmara as if they are serving Rādhikā with every one of their 72,000 prāṇas. In rāgānugā-bhakti, those who are serving their Deities like that, and others are trying to,, chase away flies. So try to follow the moods of our Gosvāmīs. […] "Rādhikāra dāsī yadi hoy abhimāna, śīghra milāiba tomāye gokula-kān." If a person has the identity, pride in the identity, "I am Rādhikā's dāsī," then Kṛṣṇa is included in that like a free gift.

title: 2008.12.07_ViG_28
en: "O Rādhikā, when will that opportunity come to me that on a dark night, I will prepare You to go in abhisāra to meet with Śrī Kṛṣṇa? I will think, 'It's a dark night this evening, so I should take a blue cloth and dress You in dark blue, so that when You move through the forest in the night, You will be completely camouflaged by the shadows. And I should remove Your ankle bells so as You sneak out from the house to go into the forest, You will not alert anyone. And then, joyfully, I will lead You secretly into the darkness along the path to meet in the forest with Śrī Kṛṣṇa.'"

title: 2011.07.15_Guru-purnima & Gurvashtaka
en: And then in this verse, Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī Ṭhākura, he's realizing in his heart, when he puts his deities to take rest at night, "Oh, my Gurudeva as Tulasī Mañjarī made this very beautiful bed. And now Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa are reclining there after taking fresh fruits, and I'm massaging the feet of Rādhikā." So what began as following vaidhī-bhakti internally became rāgānugā-bhakti and spontaneous realization.

title: Gaura-Purnima
en: “In the meantime, other maidservants, they were peeling mangoes, peeling, opening pomegranates, and pineapple, so many apples and oranges and all different types of fruit, and they were peeling and cutting them, and arranging them in beautiful patterns on plates. And they invited Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa to sit down in the courtyard of a kuñja. And they placed all the fruits before them. Kṛṣṇa was talking and laughing and joking with Rādhikā and the gopīs, and taking the fruit. And then when Kṛṣṇa finished, Rādhikā took, and then the sakhīs took their remnants. In this way, they had a nice picnic on the bank of the Yamunā in the moonlight.” “Then Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa went alone into the kuñja. And they lay down on a bed of flowers. The sakhīs went away. But some mañjarīs,” and Mahāprabhu said, “I went inside. So, as Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa relaxed and were going to sleep, some mañjarīs were fanning with cāmaras. Some were giving them tāmbūla. Some were massaging their lotus feet. And when Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa gently went to sleep, all those mañjarīs lay down on the ground in the kuñja around them.

title: Lilas and Mood of Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu
en: So Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, “Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa then, They went to sleep and then the mañjarīs came out from the kuñja and they also laid down on the platform outside the kuñja, and then I heard this loud Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, and now I came back here. Why did you bring me here? I was there resting outside the kuñja of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.” So here is another pastime where Caitanya Mahāprabhu is showing us by His own example the type of services that the followers of Rūpa Gosvāmī, they aspire to attain.
